subject: Post-POC outcomes + quick ROI vignette approval
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Martin <evan@storifyretail.com>, Lauren Price <lauren.price@storifyretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-POC outcomes + quick ROI vignette approval

Hi Evan / Lauren —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. Quick recap from our side (attached spreadsheet has the raw numbers):

- 95th‑percentile generation latency down ~42% vs baseline (measured at 1M inference calls)
- Throughput per GPU improved ~3.1x with batching/quantization settings we recommended
- Estimated per‑request cost down ~28% after KV caching and optimized kernels

Those improvements drove the customer-facing search re-rank path down from 220ms to ~128ms at peak, which matches the SLA targets you outlined.

We'd love to create a very short ROI vignette and include a one‑sentence quote from Storify that we can use on a case card and a short blog highlight. Two asks:

1) Permission to use Storify Retail as a named customer and the high‑level metrics above (no sensitive logs or PII).
2) If you’re open, a one‑line quote we can pull into the vignette. I drafted two options below for convenience — feel free to edit.

Draft quote A: “Redwood cut our inference latency by ~42%, which materially improved conversion at peak traffic.”
Draft quote B: “Switching to Redwood reduced per‑request cost by nearly 30% while improving latency and throughput.”

Could you: (a) confirm permission to publish the short vignette with the metrics, and (b) indicate which quote (A/B) you prefer or send a tweak?

If it helps, we can do a 15‑minute call to finalize the wording. I'm free Thursday 11/26 16:00–16:30 UTC or Friday 11/27 09:00–09:30 UTC.

Attached: storify_poc_kpis.xlsx (spreadsheet with the POC measurements and test harness notes)

Thanks — appreciate it.

—
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Evan Martin <evan@storifyretail.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Price <lauren.price@storifyretail.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-POC outcomes + quick ROI vignette approval

Aisha —

This is great, thanks for the clear recap. The numbers match what our infra team saw in their dashboard. We’re comfortable being named and using the high‑level metrics you shared.

For the quote, please use a slightly edited version of A:

“Redwood reduced our inference latency by ~42%, which improved peak conversion and search relevance.”

If you can keep the vignette to high‑level metrics (no raw logs or request payloads), we’re fine with publishing.

We don’t need a call unless Marissa needs further signoff on commercial terms — Lauren and I can review the one‑pager you send.

Best,
Evan Martin
Head of Engineering — Storify Retail
evan@storifyretail.com

Thanks Evan — appreciate the quick reply and the tweak.

I'm attaching a one‑page quote preview and a short vignette draft (quote_preview.pdf) with the exact wording we plan to publish. Could you review and either: approve as‑is, suggest a one‑line edit, or send a line you prefer?

Proposed published snippet:

"Redwood reduced our inference latency by ~42%, which improved peak conversion and search relevance." — Evan Martin, Head of Engineering, Storify Retail

If that works, we'll move the vignette to publish and share a final Google doc link for legal review (if your counsel requires it). Otherwise, please propose alternate wording in reply.

Also attaching the short commercial one‑pager for signature if you want to lock in Dedicated pricing.

Attachments: quote_preview.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
